verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as scheduled feed syncs or recurring workflows, is a fair question for an agentic-commerce and payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no scheduler or recurring-job capability. Batch product-feed uploads and webhooks are one-off or event-driven mechanisms, not recurring schedules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
